books.title: Sex, Meaning and the Menopause
books.author: Sue Brayne
books.description: Built from interviews with more than seventy women and men, this book gives a frank account of how sex, intimacy and relationships change around the menopause, and what that time of life can come to mean for the people going through it.

left_out: Death and dying resource pages (https://suebrayne.co.uk/death-and-dying/): still left out. They are practical end-of-life care information rather than a practice, and include pages on pain control, drug-induced hallucinations, medical terminology and advance directives (whether to be resuscitated or receive treatment), which touches on declining medical care.
